name: ligandmpnn
tagline_zh: 给定骨架和配体，重排结合口袋残基，或设计金属配位点。直接输出带设计序列的PDB，几何约束严格保留。
tagline_en: Redesign binding pockets around ligands, metals, or nucleic acids from a backbone. Get threaded PDBs directly.
desc_en: Inverse-fold a backbone with ligand, nucleic-acid, and metal context using LigandMPNN (Dauparas et al. 2023, github.com/dauparas/LigandMPNN). Reach for this skill to redesign the residues lining a binding pocket around a bound small molecule or cofactor, to design metal-coordinating sites where the geometry must be respected, or to get threaded designed-sequence PDBs out of any MPNN run.
why_zh: 同类工具多只做蛋白序列，它原生支持配体、核酸、金属，且输出PDB可直接用，省去对接步骤。
why_en: Unlike protein-only baselines, it natively handles ligand, nucleic acid, and metal contexts, outputting ready-to-use PDBs.
